homePageContent:
Lightweight, comfortable sauna hats are made from 100% natural sheep wool using the wet felting technique.
A wool sauna hat is the perfect insulator, protecting your head, hair, and ears from intense heat.

I was born in the coastal village of Salme, at a historical Viking ship crossing point. I was inspired by the juniper-covered sheep pastures where fishermen had spread out their fishing nets to repair them. It is fascinating to pass on the wisdom and experience of our ancestors through ancient felting techniques.

I am grateful to my parents, family, friends, and everyone who appreciates this art.

Discover my sauna hats and other creations in my [Etsy store](https://www.etsy.com/shop/salmefelt) or contact [me](mailto:salmefelt@gmail.com) directly.
